_README: Seeds for fixture 2 AND fixture 3. CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION — no compounds, every seed
tagged with an origin and a locator. seed-lint must return PASS on this file.
This is the shape the failed pull never had. 'turmeric curcumin' cannot enter a seed
set built this way REGARDLESS of Rules A and B: it is not an ontology monograph and no
human ever said it, so it has no origin to declare. That is Rule C, and it is the
actual guarantee — A and B just name the mistake faster.
Note the Hinglish seeds carry origin:'ontology': they are generated PROGRAMMATICALLY by
the K3 construction rule ({preferred_term} + pattern, for each pattern in the versioned
list), and each resolves to a real ontology entity. Machine-generated is auditable and
reproducible by re-running; HAND-TYPED is indistinguishable from invented once it is in
the file, which is why K4 bans 'just a few more' candidates.
